question: A certain sum of money becomes triple of itself in 8 years at simple interest. In how many years it will becomes five times of itself?
solution:
Given:

A certain sum of money becomes triple of itself in 8 years at simple interest. 

Formula used:

Simple interest = P × R × T / 100 [ P = principal, R = rate of interest, T = time]

Calculation:

Let, P = principal.

The simple interest will be 3P - P = 2P

⇒ 2P = P × R × 8 / 100

⇒ R = 25%

Again the money will be 5 times 

The simple interest will be 5P - P = 4P

⇒ 4P = P × 25 × T / 100

⇒ T = 16 years

**∴ The correct option is 3**
